# The House Always Wins - Frontend Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build the "The House Always Wins" frontend application—a verifiable, educational sports betting margin analyzer and prediction ledger.

**Architecture:** A static React application using Vite, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The app uses static JSON contracts generated by the Python backend.

**Tech Stack:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Observable Plot (or Recharts for React).

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-06-house-always-wins-frontend-design.md`

## Global Constraints
- Target WCAG 2.2 AA.
- `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` globally applied to data.
- No drop-shadows (no SaaS-card kits).
- No tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows.
- No casino imagery.
- All colors must map to the defined tokens.

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/package.json`
- Create: `frontend/tailwind.config.js`

- [ ] **Step 1: Scaffold Vite app**

```bash
rm -rf frontend
npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts
cd frontend
npm install
```

### Task 2: Shared Maths Module

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/utils/math.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `calculateImplied`, `calculateOverround`, `calculateMarginFreeProportional`, `calculateFairOdds`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the implementation**

```typescript
// frontend/src/utils/math.ts
export const calculateImplied = (odds: number) => {
  if (isNaN(odds) || odds <= 1.01 || odds >= 1000) return 0;
  return 1 / odds;
};

export const calculateOverround = (impliedProbs: number[]) => {
  const sum = impliedProbs.reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);
  return sum - 1;
};

export const calculateMarginFreeProportional = (implied: number, overround: number) => {
  if (implied === 0) return 0;
  return implied / (1 + overround);
};

export const calculateFairOdds = (marginFreeProb: number) => {
  if (marginFreeProb === 0) return 0;
  return 1 / marginFreeProb;
};
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Commit**

```bash

```

### Task 3: Margin X-Ray Component

**Files:**
- Create: `frontend/src/components/MarginXRay.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Math utilities from `math.ts`.
- Produces: React component for the Margin X-Ray page.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the component**

```tsx
// frontend/src/components/MarginXRay.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { calculateImplied, calculateOverround, calculateMarginFreeProportional, calculateFairOdds } from '../utils/math';

export const MarginXRay: React.FC = () => {
  const [odds, setOdds] = useState({ home: 1.60, draw: 4.20, away: 5.50 });

  const implied = {
    home: calculateImplied(odds.home),
    draw: calculateImplied(odds.draw),
    away: calculateImplied(odds.away),
  };

  const overround = calculateOverround([implied.home, implied.draw, implied.away]);
  
  const marginFree = {
    home: calculateMarginFreeProportional(implied.home, overround),
    draw: calculateMarginFreeProportional(implied.draw, overround),
    away: calculateMarginFreeProportional(implied.away, overround),
  };

  const fairOdds = {
    home: calculateFairOdds(marginFree.home),
    draw: calculateFairOdds(marginFree.draw),
    away: calculateFairOdds(marginFree.away),
  };

  const expectedCost = (overround / (1 + overround)) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="bg-surface border border-line rounded-[10px] p-8 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-6 border-b border-line pb-4">
        <h2 className="text-[30px] font-bold">Margin X-ray</h2>
        <div className="text-sm text-muted">Format: <span className="text-ink font-medium">Decimal</span></div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-4 mb-8">
        {['home', 'draw', 'away'].map((out) => (
          <label key={out} className="flex flex-col w-1/3">
            <span className="text-[14px] text-muted mb-1 capitalize">{out} Odds</span>
            <input 
              type="number" step="0.01" 
              value={odds[out as keyof typeof odds]} 
              onChange={e => setOdds({...odds, [out]: parseFloat(e.target.value)})}
              className="border border-line rounded-[6px] p-2 text-ink bg-bg"
            />
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>

      <table className="w-full text-left mb-8 border-collapse">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-line text-muted text-[14px]">
            <th className="py-2 font-normal">Outcome</th>
            <th className="font-normal">Odds</th>
            <th className="font-normal">Implied</th>
            <th className="font-normal">Margin-free</th>
            <th className="font-normal">Fair odds</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="text-[16px]">
          {['home', 'draw', 'away'].map((out) => (
            <tr key={out} className="border-b border-line">
              <td className="py-3 capitalize">{out}</td>
              <td>{odds[out as keyof typeof odds].toFixed(2)}</td>
              <td>{(implied[out as keyof typeof implied] * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td>
              <td>{(marginFree[out as keyof typeof marginFree] * 100).toFixed(1)}%</td>
              <td>{fairOdds[out as keyof typeof fairOdds].toFixed(2)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div className="bg-bg border border-line rounded-[6px] p-4">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
          <span className="font-bold">Overround: {(overround * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-muted">Total: {((1 + overround) * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-line rounded-full mb-3 flex overflow-hidden">
          <div className="h-full bg-muted w-[95%]"></div>
          <div className="h-full bg-cost w-[5%]"></div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[14px] text-muted">Expected cost for a bettor with no edge: <span className="text-cost font-bold">{expectedCost.toFixed(1)} per 100</span></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```
